name: frenzied_goblin_trigger_targets_a_creature_that_cannot_block
notes: Was known_bugs/frenzied_goblin_trigger_target_cant_block_never_designated (M7 mapper, 2026-11-17), fixed by engine wave E2: the trigger now designates the target its combat slot names (binding._designate routes it to the slot walker, query.combat_target_selector), and is removed with none to choose (CR 603.3d). Played on the unverified FDN record (tools/scenarios/mapped). Printed: 'Whenever this creature attacks, you may pay {R}. If you do, target creature can't block this turn.' The record writes the clause as Sneaking Guide and Goblin Smuggler write theirs: PREVENT_EFFECT(condition IS_ANY_TARGET, event DeclareBlockersEvent(filter=IS_ANY_TARGET)), behind Conditional(MAY_DONE). A trigger never designates such a target: binding._designation_slots reads TARGET Selectors and designated players only (query._designation_only_slot serves activations), so no target is chosen and the paid {R} does nothing. Expected once fixed: seat 0 attacks with Frenzied Goblin, the trigger targets Opp Ogre as it goes on the stack; with the trigger waiting seat 0 gets {R} (held priority) and pays it as the trigger resolves. Opp Ogre cannot block this turn (it is never asked); Opp Guard, not targeted, is offered the Goblin and declines; seat 1 takes 1.
